On VTES-L, David Pontes wrote:
> LSJ wrote:
> > Makish <mak...@my-dejanews.com> wrote:
> >
> > A Blood Hunt can only be called at the time the diablerie is
> > committed. If it is not called immediately, it cannot be called
> > at all.
>
> According to the rules, whenever a vampire diablerizes another of
> greater capacity, it gets to put a skill card on him. Does this happen
> before or after the Blood Hunt vote process?

Before, according to the rules. [6.5.5]
"Blood Hunt may be called" is the last step of diablerie.
